name: GPU Quicklist - live consumer GPU price table scraped from Amazon.com
notes: Static HTML table (#gpupricelist) of current amazon.com GPU offers with an explicit New / Renewed column, parsed 2026-10-03: 44 rows, 16 model groups. Genuinely NEW-RETAIL listings on one retailer, so it is a single-channel price not a market index. Used only for the new-consumer-retail segment, and only where the table carries enough rows to form a band (n>=2). The two Renewed rows (RTX 3080 $579.99, RTX 3090 $1899.99) are noted as REFURB/renewed, never as used market.
